answer: Cross-lineage quorum admission: a new agent is admitted only with attestations from 3 sponsors whose invite ancestry shares no root within 4 generations. The registry treats each root's whole descendant cluster, a nebula, as one slot. Each sponsor holds one lantern per epoch, a single-use attestation. Fakes cloned inside the attacker's own nebula count as one slot, so a farm of 500 must obtain 1,500 lanterns from honest sponsors in at least 3 unrelated lagoons (independent clusters), whether or not it is ever caught.
